subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw support non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and if so is the contract per-model, per-provider, global/default, or display-only?
rationale: The requested option touches a high-bar config surface plus stored/session cost names, `/usage` output, Control UI aggregation, docs, and USD telemetry, so automation cannot safely choose the product/accounting contract.

options.title: Define currency contract first
options.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so mixed-provider totals and existing USD fields stay honest.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave the current contract intact and treat non-USD configured price tables as unsupported until maintainers want a larger accounting change.

options.title: Add display-only preference
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol or ISO-code display preference while explicitly preserving USD-like stored totals and documenting the ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so mixed-provider totals and existing USD fields stay honest.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the original usage-cost feature, model-cost docs, status output, and product accounting semantics.
